trial_sharpe_dispersion.note: PRIMARY = spread of lineage-representative median fitness divided by the pooled within-genome per-bank sd, which assumes one common within-trial volatility. The DIRECT standard deviation of representative Sharpes is reported beside it, never instead of it; on thin data the direct number is dominated by two-observation Sharpes.
